overview.description: Bharat Forge Limited is the flagship of the Kalyani Group and one of the world's largest forging companies, manufacturing safety-critical powertrain, chassis, and industrial components for automotive, defence, aerospace, and energy sectors across 9 manufacturing locations in 6 countries.

bullets.text: India's largest manufacturer and exporter of auto components; operates the world's largest single-location forging facility at Mundhwa, Pune.

Two main verticals: Automotive (commercial vehicles, passenger vehicles) and Industrial (defence, aerospace, oil & gas, railways, energy). Auto share fell from 80% in FY07 to 58% in FY24 reflecting deliberate diversification.
Defence revenues scaled 4x YoY to ₹1,561 crore in FY24; executable defence order book stood at ₹5,192 crore as of March 31, 2024, providing 3-year revenue visibility.
Manufacturing footprint spans 9 locations in 6 countries — 2 in India, 3 in Germany, and 1 each in Sweden, Scotland, USA, and China.
Customers include the top 5 passenger car and top 5 commercial vehicle manufacturers globally; long-term agreements (LTAs) signed with key customers through 2035.
Promoter (Kalyani family) holding at ~44.1%; market cap approximately ₹93,572 crore as of recent data.
FY2024 standalone: Revenue ₹8,969 crore (+18.4% YoY), EBITDA ₹2,469 crore (+28% YoY), PAT ₹1,425 crore (+36% YoY).

financials.note: Sourced from Motilal Oswal and ICICIdirect analyst reports based on company BSE filings. FY = April–March.

products.name: Crankshafts & Front Axle Beams
products.description: Core CV forging products supplied globally. Bharat Forge was named Daimler AG's top-10 global supplier in 2016 specifically for crankshafts and front axle beams for trucks and buses.

products.name: Artillery Gun Systems (ATAGS)
products.description: Advanced Towed Artillery Gun System manufactured through subsidiary Kalyani Strategic Systems Ltd (KSSL). Export order worth USD 155.5M secured for supply to a non-conflict zone.

products.name: Aluminium Forgings / EV Components
products.description: Lightweight aluminium forged components for EV platforms; new greenfield aluminium forging capacity ramping up in North America.

products.name: Aerospace Forgings (Landing Gear & Jet Engine)
products.description: Precision forgings for landing gear components and jet engine parts. Dedicated ring mill and machining line approved; capacities coming online FY2027.
